value.rationale: The additive energy is a standard, important fourth-moment invariant for the natural sequence of even-binary-digit-sum integers. Unlike the known qualitative cubic-order estimate or signed-polynomial fourth moment, this determines its full integer-sum additive structure in every dyadic prefix and isolates the exact second-largest spectral term. It connects digit carries, Fourier moments, and additive combinatorics, with no artificial parameters or small-case restriction.
